quest.title: The Spurious Cannot Be Made Genuine
quest.description: The investment portfolio being promoted at Mimisbrunnr Books seems rather suspect...

talks.objective: Talk to the Mimisbrunnr Books regular

dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: Uh... So, I've been observing you two for a while now, and...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ooh. Spying on us, you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: Oh, no, I just... I'm often here looking for books, and just happened to notice that you two were very interested in investing. I... must advise against it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we haven't exactly been earning big, that's true... but why would you advise against trying at all?

dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: Because I suspect there can be no "generous returns" at all. The boss still has many debts to pay off, and likely won't risk taking any losses.

dialogues.speaker: Pechna
dialogues.text: My friend was once caught in a similar scam, so it would be best if the two of you didn't continue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wait, could it really be a scam...? {NICKNAME}, we've gotta find that guy and get to the bottom of this!

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Well, well, if it isn't our regulars! Here to invest again, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A little bird told me your investment coupons are a scam...

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Really now? You sure you're not just letting your imagination run wild because you've been running at a loss so far?

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Think about it. How could there be any business that only earns but never costs any capital? Some will win, and some will lose. Why, back when I was in Sumeru City... Ahem. I mean, I've been unlucky for a while now, but we can never know when that might change.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: "Hope" can only be seized by the persistent. You've gotta keep investing if you ever wanna see any return!

choices.text: Alright. Guess I'll come back again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you can't be serious. You're gonna accept it, just like that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's not gonna end well for you, buddy. We're... Right, we're the famous {NICKNAME} and Paimon. We've got plenty of friends here in Nasha Town!

response.speaker: Dhabit
response.text: "Friends"... What do you mean— Wait. Do you mean "that" kind of friends!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Huh? Uh, yeah, right! They're exactly the kind you're thinking about — and we've got lots and lots of 'em!

response.speaker: Dhabit
response.text: What!? Wh—Why didn't you say so before!? I... Uh. Look. I'm sorry, alright? I'll leave you both alone. Just... take this. All of it. Take it and go, and don't come around for coupons again — not that I'd sell you any, either...

choices.text: Trying to pull the wool over my eyes, huh?
